name: taquizas-para-eventos
description: Sitio de una sola pagina para Taquizas para Eventos (Tijuana, Baja California).
note: js/vendor/*.min.js (gsap, ScrollTrigger, lenis, split-type) and css/fonts/*.woff2 (Bricolage Grotesque, Manrope, Inter) are self-hosted, versioned copies pulled from npm at build time -- no runtime CDN dependency. If node_modules/ exists in this folder it is leftover local tooling and is not referenced by index.html; it is safe to delete.
